$comment: Fault-injection config for scripts/ui-test-mock-nube-server.mjs. Loaded once at launch (path via --scenarios=<file> or R_PLUS_UI_TEST_SCENARIOS env var; this file is the default). Every key is optional — omit or leave at defaults for a happy-path mock. Shape:

$shape.syncTimeoutMs: number|null — pull/mutations requests hang this long before responding (simulates 'La Nube no respondió a tiempo'). null/0 disables.
$shape.stuckNoKeyRoomCodes: string[] — room codes whose GET .../dek always returns { dek: null }, simulating an encrypted room with no key delivered yet.
$shape.staleRevisionRoomCodes: string[] — room codes whose POST .../mutations always fails with 409 revision_stale.
$shape.rateLimitedLoginUsernames: string[] — usernames whose POST /auth/login always fails with 429 rate_limited + Retry-After.
